div.p: Mapping from https://srl.org.nz/regimens to HemOnc Ontology (fragment, Phase 0 spike)

tr.td: 52101000210105 (CRC Metastatic – mFOLFOX6 [bolus and infusion] [high dose folinic acid] v2.0.2)
Oxaliplatin 85/2h, folinic acid 400/2h, 5-FU 400 bolus + 2400/46h, q14d. Infusion durations match.
588251000210108 (CRC Metastatic – mFOLFOX6 [high dose folinic acid] (no bolus) v1.0.0)
omit-action: fluorouracil 400 mg/m² bolus. No HemOnc variant drops the bolus at otherwise identical doses.
52201000210102 (CRC Adjuvant – mFOLFOX6 [low dose folinic acid] v2.0.0)
replace-dose: folinic acid 400 mg/m² IV 2 h → 50 mg flat IV 2 min. Lowest HemOnc leucovorin dose for mFOLFOX6 is 200 mg/m².
